default_lifecycle_paragraph: **Default lifecycle (all supported hosts):** task — goal drive via `framework_goal_drive` + `artifacts/current/<task_id>/` manual boards only (no hook GOAL_CONTINUE/RFV/digest). REVIEW_GATE Stop is **advisory-only on all hosts**; `task` suppresses review nudge and spawn-first. Legacy `/gsd-*` removed (2026-05); use My commands only.

lifecycle_by_host.cursor: **Default lifecycle:** task — Goal/Quality Gate: `framework_goal_drive` / `framework_quality_gate` stdio + `artifacts/current/<task_id>/` manual boards only (no hook GOAL_CONTINUE/QUALITY_GATE/digest, 2026-05). REVIEW_GATE Stop advisory-only (Claude canonical clearance); `task` suppresses review nudge and spawn-first.
lifecycle_by_host.claude: **Default lifecycle:** task — Goal/Quality Gate via stdio + manual boards; `router-rs claude hook` does not inject GOAL_CONTINUE/QUALITY_GATE/digest. REVIEW_GATE Stop advisory-only (Claude canonical clearance); `task` suppresses review nudge and spawn-first.
lifecycle_by_host.opencode: **Default lifecycle:** task (same chain). Goal drive via MCP stdio; review Stop advisory-only (Claude canonical clearance; MCP ADVISORY); closeout may hard-block at MCP tool level when evidence unsatisfied (separate from REVIEW_GATE). No shell hook bundle on this transport.
lifecycle_by_host.codex: **Default lifecycle:** task (same chain). Goal/Quality Gate via `framework_goal_drive` / `framework_quality_gate` stdio + manual boards only; no continuity digest or GOAL_CONTINUE/QUALITY_GATE_CONTINUE on hooks. REVIEW_GATE Stop advisory-only; `task` suppresses review nudge and spawn-first.

research_harness_paragraph: **Research harness (五宿主同一 NL 路由):** 非手稿发现 → `$research-discovery`；非手稿执行（实验/建模/核查）→ `$research-execution`；手稿 → `$paper-workbench`；引用 → `$citation-management`（+ `citation_tool_rs audit`）；深度 Web 调研 → `$deep-research` 或 `external_research` lane。显式启用：`research_loadout`（`skills/SKILL_LOADOUTS.json`）。地图：`skills/research-discovery/SKILL.md` + `skills/research-execution/SKILL.md`。
review_findings_only_paragraph: **Code review default (all hosts): findings-only.** Explicit `$code-review-deep` or review requests still apply at skill layer; REVIEW_GATE never hard-blocks Stop on any host (advisory nudge only). `task` suppresses review Stop nudge and spawn-first. See `skills/code-review-deep/SKILL.md`.
